title: The Mischief Moles and the Kingdom of the Ants
summary: Elliot the Elephant has lost his precious gemstones, prompting the expert mystery solvers, Disco and Visco the Mischief Moles, to spring into action. Digging deep beneath the earth, the duo navigates through dark caves and treacherous mud until they stumble upon a bustling underground civilization: the Kingdom of the Ants and Worms. With the help of some unexpected friends and their magical Mousketools, the moles delve even deeper to uncover a mysterious wooden box. Inside, they find the radiant treasure and return it to their grateful elephant friend, proving no mystery is too deep for the Mischief Moles.

transcript.text: Let's tell a story about the Mischief Moles find the missing gem of Elliot the Elephant.

transcript.text: Click, click. Disco and Thisco switched on their headlamps and then they could see in the dark. And then as they dug a tunnel at the back of the cave, deeper and deeper down into the ground, they started to notice something funny.

transcript.text: What?

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: The ground was getting mucky. They were digging into damp, mucky mud. So what did they have to do now?

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And Disco said, "Yeah, I don't think the gem is in this mucky mud. We must have made a wrong turn somewhere." And Thisco said, "Okay, let's back up." And so they went back up the tunnel and dug in a different direction. Dig, dig, dig, dig, dig.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: So you have been digging in the left. I want you to dig at the right.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And so instead of digging to the left, they dug to the right. Dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig. And suddenly there was a click as Disco's claw, instead of digging into dirt, it smacked against something hard. And what was it?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Keep telling the story and then you'll find out.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And Disco said, "Oh my gosh, maybe it's the gemstone." But Thisco looked over and said, "No, it's just a rock." But Disco picked up the thing and said, "Wait a minute, it's not the gemstone or a rock. It's..." What was it?

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Well, keep the story, then you'll find out.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: It was a little toy car. And Disco said, "Huh, this isn't a gemstone. What's it doing deep underground?" And Thisco said, "I don't know. Let's keep it, though. It looks like a nice little car." And Disco said, "Okay, we gotta keep digging." And so dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: They dug and dug and dug until suddenly, poof, Thisco put his claw right through a wall of dirt, whoosh, into the open air. And Disco said, "What happened? You stopped." And Thisco said, "I think, I think I found an empty chamber deep under the ground.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: It's all dark." And Disco said, "Oh, just point your headlamp in there." And Thisco looked inside, and it was a big chamber full of... Who lived there? It was some kind of creature maybe.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: It was ants and worms.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: Ants and worms. It was a big city deep underground where ants lived and worms lived. It was the kingdom of the ants. And the worms were their friends. They also lived there. But the ants were the smart ones that built little buildings, and they scurried all around.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And Disco and Thisco looked into the entrance to this chamber from the little tunnel that they had dug into the huge space, and they were amazed because there were millions of ants running this way and that way along the floor and the walls and the ceiling and in and out.

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: And there was, and there was worms wiggling about.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: There was worms wiggling about. And the ants were building little buildings everywhere and tending to their eggs and growing new babies and storing their food. And the worms were wriggling through the dirt in the floor. And they said, "Look what we found, a whole world under the ground where the ants and worms live."

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And Thisco said, "Um, but we didn't find the mystery gem yet." But Disco said, "Yeah, but maybe they'll know." And so he said, "Huh, how could we find out?" What do you think they could try?

transcript.speaker: Dad

transcript.speaker: Dad

transcript.speaker: Izzy
transcript.text: Did I hear you say Mystery Mousekatool?

transcript.text: Uh, yes, said Disco and Thisco. Who, who is it?

transcript.text: Oh, hi, Mickey and Minnie. What are you doing here?

transcript.speaker: Izzy

transcript.text: Well, we do, because we just found the kingdom of the ants and worms, and we need to ask them about the missing gem.

And Disco and Thisco went digging right down straight through the ground below the kingdom of the mouse- of the ants and the worms and they went dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And finally, clunk, the shovel bonked against something hard and made of wood. It wasn't a gemstone, but Disco started to scrape the dirt off it and Disco said, "What's that?" It seems to be big and rectangular and Thisco said, "I think it's, um..."

transcript.speaker: Izzy

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: A puzzle piece? "No, it's bigger than a puzzle piece would be. It's almost as big as me," said Thisco. And he started to tug on it and it came out of the dirt and Disco said, "Wow, it's a big box. How are we gonna open it?" And Thisco said, "Well, it's got a lid."

transcript.speaker: Izzy

transcript.speaker: Izzy

transcript.text: Oh, and D- and Thisco went cut, cut, cut, cut, cut and he cut through the side of the box to open it right up and he lifted the top and suddenly when he pointed his headlamp down into the box, the whole tunnel that they were in was sparkling with colored light in red and purple and yellow.

transcript.speaker: Dad
transcript.text: And Disco said, "Oh my gosh, what's in there?" And Thisco said, "I think it's the gemstones," because everything was sparkling as the light shining from his headlamp bounced off the beautiful shiny gemstone, gemstones that were inside the box. And Thisco said, "I think we did it.

transcript.text: We found them." And Disco said, "Hooray!" And so they gathered up the gemstones and they brought them back up past the kingdom of the ants and the worms, up the tunnel, through the muck, out the deep dark cave and back to the elephant who said... What'd the elephant say?

transcript.text: And Disco and Thisco said, "Oh, it's all in a day's work for us Mischief Moles." And that's the end of the story.

characters.name: Disco
characters.description: An energetic Mischief Mole and superhero-clad detective, Disco is one of two identical twins who embark on grand adventures through the deep. Alongside her sister Thisco, this architect of the subterranean maps hidden realms—from frozen frontiers to the dusty canyons beneath the furniture—by piloting her signature submarine or racing toy cars through the bedroom's wild heights. Guided by "Cornebyborn" dances and Papa Mole’s lore, she finds solace within her glowing basket house, a dream sanctuary and fortress of a hundred locks. Whether navigating grimy domestic landscapes or open waters, Disco balances mechanical ingenuity with a persistent, soft-hearted wonder for the night sky.

characters.name: Visco
characters.description: A mole detective and partner to Disco.

characters.name: Elliot
characters.description: A guest invited on board the spaceship who enters through the special door.

characters.name: Mickey
characters.description: One of Mistress Mouse’s storied stuffy mice, this famous plush adventurer is a visionary benefactor who manifests fragrant blooms from magic Legos and pilots his Mousecar through lightless depths. Whether arming moles for Kitty’s investigations or securing solutions for Frasgle, he remains fiercely loyal to Minnie, Mole, Izzy, and Hattie. Accompanied by a cheerful infant and shadowed by a friend’s disappearance, his haste to reach the spires of Peacock’s castle has left him without essential provisions, miring him in a sudden, hungry peril.

characters.name: Minnie
characters.description: A wise veteran of briny depths and interstellar frontiers, Mickey’s resourceful mouse companion and confidant to the Princess of Mouseland guides Izzy and Hattie with a glowing lantern and ingenious Mystery Mousketools. Having recently breathed life into a towering guardian of interlocking bricks, this intrepid traveler now points the way toward the mountain’s peak, pausing to investigate the savory aroma of bacon-scented mushrooms while serving as a compassionate friend whose seasoned instincts help decipher Frasgle’s complex roars and sounds.
